2610.10266.title: LoomSC: Scalable Deep Subspace Clustering with Projector Factorization and Exact Spectral Reduction
2610.10266.paper_summary: Dense self-expression matrices and full-affinity spectral clustering limit the scalability of subspace clustering. We introduce the Latent Orthogonal Optimization Model for Subspace Clustering (LoomSC), a framework that addresses both bottlenecks through projector factorization and exact spectral reduction. Motivated by the spectral structure of least-squares regression, LoomSC jointly learns latent features and a projector self-representation through two thin factors. Alternating Procrustes and least-squares updates preserve the sample factor's orthogonality while keeping the coefficient matrix implicit. We construct a nonnegative quadratic affinity that preserves the projector's support. An exact feature map then reduces its normalized spectral problem to an eigenproblem whose dimension depends only on the factor width. Neither the full affinity nor the sample Laplacian needs to be formed. Our analysis quantifies the projector approximation and identifies conditions for subspace preservation and within-subspace connectivity. For fixed dimensions and iteration budgets, the complete pipeline has linear time and memory complexity in the number of samples. Across five image-clustering benchmarks, LoomSC ranks first or second in all 15 dataset-metric comparisons against 9 state-of-the-art baselines. Its mean accuracy exceeds the highest baseline mean by 6.66 percentage points. Synthetic experiments scale to 500,000 samples while maintaining at least 99.8% accuracy.
2610.10266.paper_summary_zh: 密集的自我表達矩陣和全相似度光譜聚類限制了子空間聚類的可擴展性。 我們引入了子空間聚類的潛在正交優化模型（LoomSC），這是一個通過投影因子分解和精確光譜降維來解決這兩個瓶頸的框架。 受到最小二乘回歸的光譜結構的啟發，LoomSC 通過兩個細因子共同學習潛在特徵和投影自表示。 交替 Procrustes 和最小二乘更新在保持樣本因子的正交性的同時，保持係數矩陣隱含。 我們構建了一個非負二次相似度，保持投影的支持。 然後，精確的特徵映射將其歸一化光譜問題簡化為一個特徵問題，其維度僅依賴於因子的寬度。 無需形成完整的相似度或樣本拉普拉斯。 我們的分析量化了投影近似，並確定了子空間保留和子空間內連通性的條件。 對於固定的維度和迭代預算，完整的流程在樣本數量上具有線性時間和內存複雜度。 在五個圖像聚類基準測試中，LoomSC 在所有 15 個數據集-指標比較中排名第一或第二，對比 9 個最先進的基準。 它的平均準確率超過了最高基準平均值 6.66 個百分點。 合成實驗擴展到 500,000 個樣本，同時保持至少 99.8% 的準確率。
